name: A Mans Reputation
overview: Scripture emphasizes the paramount value of a man's reputation, highlighting that mercy and truth should be deeply ingrained in his heart to gain favor with both God and man. A good name is esteemed above great riches, reflecting the enduring blessing of a righteous memory contrasted with the decay of the wicked's name. The integrity of one's actions, even from childhood, reveals the true character that shapes reputation, while faithful men stand out as rare and precious in a world where many proclaim their own goodness.
